The main takeaway from our work is that

the irrigation time is a key variable in the accumulation of heavy metals, and the presence of organic matter in the soils is an important variable that can influence the mobility and accumulation of heavy metals.
the use of raw wastewater as irrigation water is not a sustainable practice in the long run, especially when the soils are already saline and sodic.
there is a significant accumulation of boron and lead in the topsoil of the DR03, and this accumulation could be associated with the long-term irrigation of soils with raw wastewater.
